tiers.definition: In production or mainnet for about 2 years or more, maintained in the last 6 months, and a category leader by measurable adoption or reference status.
Live in production or mainnet with real, evidenced usage, maintained in the last 6 to 12 months.
Early mainnet, beta or limited usage, or a public testnet with active development in the last 6 months.
Research, spec, devnet, announced, hackathon-stage, or dormant (no visible activity for 12 months or more, death not confirmed).
Graveyard: confirmed shut down, abandoned (site gone and no activity for 24 months or more), sanctioned or seized, or pivoted away from privacy.
Listed without a tier while evidence is checked.
